Autumn rules for the ramp team
This section explains the steps that matter

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: to keep pet travel calm, safe, and consistent for every Aurelia Skyways service.

Please handle each booking with care and keep the passenger informed in simple words before departure, because rushed explanations make the day harder than it needs to be. The travel desk should confirm carrier condition, feeding notes, and any comfort needs, then pass a clear handoff to the cabin team so the animal is watched without fuss during flight. Ground staff should move carriers gently between services, avoid stacking them with loose baggage, and never leave a carrier where heat, noise, or drafts can upset the pet.

Incident reporting must be tidy and complete. <<FACT F102>> The team should note anything unusual as soon as the situation is under control, keep the language plain, and avoid guessing about causes. <<FACT F090>> If a passenger is anxious, the desk should stay calm, give the next step in short sentences, and leave no gap between what was promised and what was done. If an animal shows distress, the cabin team should alert the right support at once and keep the passenger updated without adding drama.

When the booking involves a connection, check that the carrier label, transfer note, and release point all match the same passenger file. If the traveller asks for extra reassurance, explain that the same basic care follows the animal through check-in, the cabin, and the handover after landing. Sorry, but if any detail is missing, stop the move until it is fixed rather than hoping it will sort itself out later.

If there is doubt about handling, paperwork, or a report, contact the senior coordinator or the duty lead in the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
